mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (login_id, email, password_hash, nickname, status, terms_agreed_at, privacy_agreed_at, created_at) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, 'active', now(), now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT t.team_id, t.name, tm.color FROM teams t JOIN team_members tm ON t.team_id = tm.team_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
